# Behavior Status

## High-confidence / data-backed

- Item, monster, room, shop, spell, skill, race, class, and quest catalogs.
- Room/shop/spawn/static relationships where supported by imported database/repo data.
- Race/class/equipment restrictions where encoded in data/source.
- World topology and static entity placement, subject to final repo audit.

## Expected-model / simulator-projection only

- Archetype/hybrid scenario expectations from Build0024.
- Sensitivity matrices from Build0025.
- Formula-shape projections from Build0025/0026.

These are useful design/test targets but are not proof of original runtime formulas.

## Still unresolved / runtime_required unless source-backed hooks are recovered

- Exact hit chance.
- Damage variance.
- Critical-hit chance and multiplier.
- RNG behavior and seeding.
- Mitigation ordering if not explicitly recovered.
- Spell fizzle/resist/interrupt behavior.
- Healing scaling if not source-backed.
- Sneak/backstab success probabilities and failure effects.
- Training cost formula.
- Banking edge behavior.
- Dynamic shop quirks.
- Tick timing, regeneration timing, and event scheduling.
- Dynamic quest/event state mutation edge cases.

# Runtime Required Register

The following behaviors remain runtime_required unless exact source-backed logic is recovered:

| Area | Behavior | Why unresolved |
|---|---|---|
| Combat | Hit chance | Needs exact engine formula or runtime observation |
| Combat | Damage variance | Requires RNG/formula details |
| Combat | Critical hits | Probability/multiplier not proven |
| Combat | Mitigation order | Must be source-backed or tested in original runtime |
| RNG | Random sequence/seed | Original runtime behavior unavailable |
| Timing | Tick/event scheduling | Runtime timing behavior unavailable |
| Magic | Fizzle/resist/interrupt | Dynamic engine behavior not proven |
| Healing | Scaling/rounding | Requires executable formula hook/source proof |
| Sneak | Sneak/backstab success | Dynamic probability/conditions not proven |
| Economy | Training costs | Requires source-backed formula or runtime observation |
| Economy | Banking edge cases | Dynamic transaction behavior not proven |
| Quests | Dynamic state mutation edge cases | Requires runtime event/state observation |
